title: Curved 3D packaging customiser with live DOM labels
blurb: A live HTML product label wrapped round a 3D coffee tin or vinyl sleeve in WebGL. Spin the object, edit text and controls on the curved surface, unroll it flat and export a PNG.
question: Can a live editable HTML product label wrap around a curved 3D coffee tin or vinyl sleeve in WebGL so you can spin the object, type and click directly onto the curved surface, and flatten it to a print-ready PNG?
